caption: pick a bedtime boundary before you get into bed. which one would you actually keep?

sources.claim: Earnit feature mechanics; no customer outcome claims. Current brief overrides older hidden-feature references.

copy.title: 5 ways to make bedtime less scrollable
1. lose the color
copy.body: try grayscale in the evening. your home screen can be boring.

copy.title: 2. quiet the group chat
copy.body: mute nonessential notifications before getting into bed.

copy.title: 3. give the charger a new home
copy.body: put it outside your bedroom before you get comfortable.

copy.title: 4. earn minutes before opening earnit sessions
5. leave the phone before lying down
copy.body: make the choice while you are still standing. save this for tonight.
